name: Nostr
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: A fake token project named "Nostr" on the Ethereum chain has run away, and its funds have been transferred to a new EOA address 0xeeB8EB5CC144eDddDB204c3ABA499de6b6081696. In the end, the fraudsters made a profit of 232.1 ETH, worth about $370,000. The token contract is 0xA2be922174605BAd450775C76CEb632369480336.
